import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(9, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='sex', y='survived', hue='pclass', palette='viridis', errorbar=None)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Titanic Survival Rate by Sex and Passenger Class', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sex', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1], labels=['Female', 'Male'], fontsize=10) # More descriptive labels for sex
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Customize legend
plt.legend(title='Passenger Class', title_fontsize='11', fontsize='10', loc='upper right')

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Ensure layout is tight
plt.tight_layout()
